entities.name: Hugo Gutmann
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugo Gutmann, later known as Henry G. Grant, was a German Jewish army officer, notable for being one of Adolf Hitler's superior officers in World War I. During the war, he recommended Hitler for the award of the Iron Cross.
